key_insight: QUANTA combines specialized AI agents with deterministic instrument-action validation to enable closed-loop quantum-materials characterization.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a path to automating expertise-intensive PPMS experiments through adaptive planning, troubleshooting and data interpretation.
method: Retrieve evidence from scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements.
Use specialized agents to plan experiments, troubleshoot issues and interpret results.
Validate instrument actions deterministically and revise measurement plans using incoming data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations involving transport measurements of TaP and nonlinear-response investigations in Co2MnGa, but provides no quantitative performance benchmarks.
watch_item: Reliable deployment requires instrument-specific validation and safeguards; generalization beyond the reported demonstrations remains to be established.
paper_title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
